description_en: Queries the list of prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的禁用软件列表
name: ListProhibitedSoftware

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the software prohibition policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~): Lists software prohibition policies.
[CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~): Creates a software prohibition policy
parameters.help_zh:
软件禁用策略ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~)：批量查询软件禁用策略。
[CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~)：创建软件禁用策略
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the prohibited software
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The operating system type for which the prohibited software has configured processes
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件已配置进程的操作系统类型
parameters.name: device_type

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the prohibited software is a system built-in prohibited software. Valid values:
true: A system built-in prohibited software that is shared across all Alibaba Cloud accounts and cannot be modified or deleted.
false: Custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh:
该禁用软件是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The ID of the prohibited software. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~): Lists prohibited software.
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~): Creates custom prohibited software
fields.help_zh:
禁用软件ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~)：批量查询禁用软件。
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~)：创建自定义禁用软件
fields.name: software_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of prohibited software IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: software_ids

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the prohibited software tag is a system built-in tag. Valid values:
true: A system built-in tag that is shared across all Alibaba Cloud accounts and cannot be modified or deleted.
false: A custom tag under the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh:
该禁用软件标签是否为系统内置标签。取值：
true：系统内置标签，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义标签
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The ID of the prohibited software tag. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~): Lists prohibited software tags.
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~): Creates a custom prohibited software tag
fields.help_zh:
禁用软件标签ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~)：批量查询禁用软件标签。
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~)：创建自定义禁用软件标签
fields.name: tag_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the prohibited software tag
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签的唯一标识
parameters.name: tag_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the prohibited software was created, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 禁用软件的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

Description.description_en: The description of the prohibited software

DynamicPolicyIds.description_en: The collection of dynamic policy IDs that reference the prohibited software as a disposal action
DynamicPolicyIds.description_zh: 引用该禁用软件作为处置动作的动态策略ID集合

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the software is a system built-in prohibited software. Valid values:
true: A system built-in prohibited software that is shared across all Alibaba Cloud accounts and cannot be modified or deleted.
false: Custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件

LinuxProcesses.description_en: The list of process configurations for the Linux operating system
LinuxProcesses.description_zh: Linux操作系统下的进程配置列表

BundleId.description_en: The application bundle identifier (Bundle ID). This parameter is required only for macOS processes
BundleId.description_zh: 应用包标识（Bundle ID），仅macOS进程需要填写

Cmdline.description_en: The command-line parameters for starting the process

Name.description_en: The name of the prohibited software

PolicyIds.description_en: The collection of software prohibition policy IDs that directly reference the prohibited software
PolicyIds.description_zh: 直接引用该禁用软件的软件禁用策略ID集合

SoftwareId.description_en: The ID of the prohibited software

TagIds.description_en: The collection of prohibited software tag IDs associated with the prohibited software
TagIds.description_zh: 该禁用软件已关联的禁用软件标签ID集合
